summary: BidBlitz Design System and Visual QA Testing - All critical tests PASSED. Verified /design-system route loads with shell, token cards, MoneyAmount (German formatting 53,72 €), CountdownTimer, ProductImageGallery with metadata attributes, button/card examples, and sticky CTA. Sticky CTA navigates to /auctions without blank screen. /auctions page loads for guest users with German price formatting, no horizontal overflow at 320px/390px. Auction detail shows ProductImageGallery with required data-testid and metadata attributes, no forbidden English phrases. /taxi page loads in dark BidBlitz style, usable at 320px/390px, sticky booking CTA visible above safe area, German price formatting (0,00 €), ETA labels use German style, region label shows 'Deine Region' (translated). Bottom nav visible on auctions, hidden on taxi fullscreen mode.
critical_code_review_comments: DesignSystemPage.jsx: Clean implementation with all required data-testid attributes for Visual QA
MoneyAmount component correctly uses German locale formatting (comma decimal, € suffix)
CountdownTimer shows German duration format (Tg., Std., Min., Sek.)
ProductImageGallery includes all required metadata attributes (data-product-category, data-image-verified, data-image-source)
AuctionGridCard uses MoneyAmount for German price formatting, countdown does not overlap price at narrow widths
AuctionDetail uses ProductImageGallery with proper testId and metadata, no forbidden English phrases found
TaxiPage correctly implements fullscreen mode (taxi-fullscreen-mode class), hides bottom nav
TaxiPage region label shows 'Deine Region' instead of raw 'default'
All pages pass horizontal overflow test at 320px and 390px widths
test_credentials: No credentials required - guest flows only
context_for_next_testing_agent: Design System and Visual QA testing complete: (1) /design-system route loads with BidBlitz Design System shell, token cards (Hintergrund, Karte, Cyan, Warnung), MoneyAmount examples with German formatting (53,72 €, 1.999,00 €, 63,4 Mio. €), CountdownTimer examples, ProductImageGallery with metadata, button examples (Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Danger), card examples, and sticky CTA. (2) Sticky CTA navigates to /auctions without blank screen. (3) /auctions page loads for guest with 92 auction cards, German price formatting (11,28 €), no horizontal overflow at 320px/390px. (4) Auction detail shows ProductImageGallery with data-testid='auction-detail-gallery' and metadata (product_category=mobility, image_verified=true, image_source=auction-gallery), German price (11,29 €), countdown (2 Tg. 11 Std. 27 Min. 38 Sek.), no forbidden English phrases. (5) /taxi page loads in dark BidBlitz style, usable at 320px/390px, sticky booking CTA visible, German formatting, region shows 'Deine Region'. (6) Bottom nav visible on auctions, hidden on taxi fullscreen. KYC remains disabled globally as expected.
